text:
maria.su: FYI customer is seeing huge p95 spikes on /v1/rerank under load — lots of 504/502s during peak. Customer says latency p95 jumped from ~150ms to >1.2s and error rate spiked to ~4%.

acme-sre: Confirmed. Happened during a campaign window. We sent a batch of ~180 candidates per request at ~450 qps. Request id: abc123-def456. Logs attached.

tj-ng: looking. Can you paste a sample payload and the client retry settings? Also which region?

acme-sre: region=us-west-2. Client retries: 3 attempts, linear 50ms backoff. Sample payload: ```{
  "query": "find similar docs",
  "candidates": ["id1", "id2", ..., "id180"]
}```

support-bot: Incident INC-3419 created by @maria.su (priority=P2)

ana-ml: Saw similar symptoms earlier — retries + large candidate counts can amplify backend load and thrash k/v cache. Any gateway logs showing retry amplification?

maria.su: Gateway shows a lot of proxied retries around the same root ts. Example: ``proxy: forwarded request abc123 -> rerank-svc (504 after 30s)`` and ``rerank-svc: 502 read error``.

jason-ops: Quick mitigation ideas: 1) throttle the customer route at gateway (reduce concurrency to 50), 2) drop client retry budget to 1 for rerank path, 3) short-circuit very large candidate sets server-side (return 400 if >100) while we triage. Can ops apply 1 & 2 now?

maria.su: Ops applied a temporary gate: max_concurrency=60 and gateway retry_limit=1 for /v1/rerank for that org. Early numbers: p95 went from 1.2s -> ~230ms, error rate down to ~1.1%. Still seeing some 502s from rerank-svc.

ana-ml: Repro plan for eng: 1) run a load test that sends 600 qps with 200-candidate payloads; 2) observe rerank-svc memory and KV cache metrics; 3) check for GC spikes and connection resets. I suspect hot-shard and evictions causing backend RPCs to hit fallback code path producing 502.

acme-sre: We can run the load script. Any sample k6/curl?

tj-ng: sample k6 snippet: ```js
import http from 'k6/http';
export default function() {
  const payload = JSON.stringify({query: 'x', candidates: Array.from({length:200}, (_,i)=>'id'+i)});
  http.post('https://api.redwood.com/v1/rerank', payload, {headers:{'Authorization':'Bearer X','Content-Type':'application/json'}});
}
```

jason-ops: From initial traces: many failed requests share the same payload fingerprint and were retried by client and by the gateway. That causes duplicate in-flight work on rerank-svc and k/v cache thrash. Two-pronged fix: short-term gating + client guidance; long-term: dedupe identical simultaneous requests in gateway (fingerprint + coalescing with 1s TTL) and server-side request size limit.

ana-ml: Also propose adding a server-side idempotency/hash header option so gateway/clients can de-duplicate retries. And emit a metric that counts duplicate fingerprints per second so we can alert if retry amplification > 0.5%.

maria.su: Eng action items: 
- @tj-ng: put together a minimal PR to add request fingerprint coalescing in gateway (TTL 1s) and a feature flag.
- @ana-ml: add rate-limited 400 response when candidates > 100 and telemetry event.
- @jason-ops: prepare rollback/mitigation runbook and apply short-term config across org.

tj-ng: already started a branch with coalescing logic stub. Repro before/after in staging scheduled tonight. Will include benchmarks for added latency (expected <2ms).

acme-sre: After ops gate we saw immediate improvement, happy to participate in staging repro.

maria.su: For the runbook, SRE please include exact repro steps: 
1) run k6 script at 600 qps with 200 candidates for 3m.
2) capture gateway logs with `kubectl logs -l app=gateway --since=10m` and rerank-svc logs.
3) export p95 from console and check `rerank.svc.5xx` metric.
4) if 5xx > 1% escalate to eng with traces and request ids.

jason-ops: Added those steps to the incident page and tagged followup ticket INFRA-892.

maria.su: Closing immediate escalation — ops will keep the gate for 24h. Eng to deploy coalescing + size-limit patch in canary tomorrow. Thanks all :thumbsup:
